scripts.build: vite build --config vite.config.ext.ts && tsc && vite build
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && tauri build && npm run desktop:copy
scripts.desktop:copy: shx mkdir -p build/windows/standalone build/windows/msi && shx cp src-tauri/target/release/app.exe build/windows/standalone/TestManga.exe && shx cp src-tauri/target/release/bundle/msi/TestManga*.msi build/windows/msi/TestManga.msi
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.mobile:apk:debug: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && npm run mobile:copy:debug
scripts.mobile:apk:release: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && gradlew bundleRelease assembleRelease && cd .. && npm run mobile:copy:release
scripts.mobile:copy:debug: shx mkdir -p build/android && shx cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk build/android/TestManga-debug.apk
scripts.build:all:debug: npm run desktop:build:debug && npm run mobile:apk:debug && npm run web:build:exe:debug
scripts.build:all:release: npm run desktop:build && npm run mobile:apk:release && npm run web:build:exe
